name: gate_a_extract
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import zipfile,json,hashlib,stat,os,pathlib
assert not os.path.exists("src") or not os.listdir("src")
assert not os.path.exists("build") or not os.listdir("build")
os.makedirs("src",exist_ok=True);os.makedirs("build",exist_ok=True);os.makedirs("cache",exist_ok=True);os.makedirs("results",exist_ok=True)
sh=json.load(open("packet/SOURCE-HASHES.json"))
print(type(sh), list(sh.items())[:3] if isinstance(sh,dict) else sh[:3])
z=zipfile.ZipFile("packet/382297-source-only.zip")
names=[]
for i in z.infolist():
    n=i.filename
    assert not n.startswith("/") and ".." not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(n).parts and "\\" not in n, n
    mode=i.external_attr>>16
    assert not stat.S_ISLNK(mode), n
    assert not i.is_dir(), n
    names.append(n)
print(len(names))
print(names)
assert len(set(names))==len(names)
for i in z.infolist():
    b=z.read(i)
    base=pathlib.PurePosixPath(i.filename).name
    t=pathlib.Path("src")/base
    assert not t.exists()
    t.write_bytes(b)
print(sorted(os.listdir("src")))
